title.narrative: Accelerating the implementation of prevention services and quality care in the fight against the epidemics of HIV and TB - Togo (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Togo, Tuberculosis, Primature de la République Togolaise (PMT)This program has the following goals: Contributing to the elimination of tuberculosis in Togo. The objectives of this program are: Reduce the incidence of TB in Togo from 37 cases per 100,000 inhabitants in 2019 to 34 cases per 100,000 inhabitants in 2023.. Reduce the tuberculosis mortality rate from 2.7 cases per 100,000 inhabitants in 2019 to 1.44 cases per 100,000 inhabitants in 2023. Strengthen the management and coordination capacities of the programme and actors at all levels, including community actors.
